body: From the DM-169 review (orchestrator): `src/core/space/rubric.ts` `gradeSpace` is the reference grader; extend it rather than writing a second calculator. Fix the drift in `src/core/space/baselines.ts` `compareCandidates`: it compares cohort sampleSize before frozenAt, but docs/space-grading.md Baselines rule 4 (and its docstring) says the latest frozen version wins first. Make code and doc agree. dispatchedAt and frozenAt must come from server-side lifecycle records, never the caller.
